recentItems.title: Alberta is voting on staying in Canada. Here's a look at other separatist movements.
recentItems.description:
The province of Alberta is voting to either remain in Canada or begin the process for a binding referendum on separation from the country. Ian Lee takes a look at other separatist movements seen in Canada and around the world.
